objective: Test retrieval behavior on Canadian case law and legislation with human-authored pinpoint gold before designing the final hybrid.
why_now: LegalBench-RAG contains contracts and privacy policies but no case law, courts, citations, or statute-section gold.
The short DOCX projection exercised tables, bilingual text, pages, headings, and cross-references, but most files were cheap to read whole.
The description ablation selected the shared routed description, while two recovered calls showed that the nominal coding schema still advertised a project-specific section handle.

bed.name: beaver-can-pinpoint
bed.source: Every required_authorities entry in every committed benchmarks/beaver_can/tasks/dev task at implementation freeze time.
bed.cell: One cell per human-defined proposition and required source. The question is the human definitions[proposition_id] text prefixed only by an instruction to return the exact supporting passage.
bed.documents: The required A2AJ source text only, ingested through the real local DOCX path under a deterministic opaque doc-<hash>.docx filename. Citation, case name, statute name, task id, source id, role, and manifest filename are not exposed in the filename or question.
bed.gold: Every human-accepted pinpoint for the required authority resolves through the existing Beaver-CAN SourceDoc block map. Exact trimmed source slices are alternative acceptable passages, not passages the answer must reproduce cumulatively.
bed.provenance_label: human-gold-derived mechanism diagnostic; not a new independent human benchmark and not hidden holdout gold
fail_closed_checks: All task, gold, and manifest contracts parse through loadBeaverCanTaskDir.
Every required source is an A2AJ fixture with a compiled SourceDoc.
Every acceptable pinpoint resolves to one exact non-empty source slice.
Every ingested DOCX text plane is byte-identical after LF normalization.
Every question is non-empty and contains neither its source citation nor its opaque filename.
No model call begins unless all checks pass.

upstream.surface: Pinned Will Chen Mike upstream retrieval schemas and harness adapter already frozen by the fair-baseline registration.

p0-pure-coding.read_contract: File and 1-based line windows only. No provision, paragraph, table, row, cell, page, or graph parameter or result annotation.
p0-pure-coding.description: The selected routed rule, adapted only to remove unavailable structural vocabulary.
p0-pure-coding.purpose: Give familiar coding-agent tools a genuinely isolated baseline.

d1-routed.read_contract: The existing structure-enriched coding surface: line windows plus verified provision, paragraph, table, row, and cell handles emitted on matching lines.
d1-routed.description: The selected routed description from the preregistered d0/d1/d2 ablation.
d1-routed.purpose: Measure the marginal value and cost of legal structure inside the coding shape.

address.surface: The current project-native address retrieval surface.
address.purpose: Project-native comparison with legal structure exposed through dedicated tools.

live_design.provider_tier_policy: default economy tier; record actual tier

primary: any acceptable pinpoint reached by a committed read
integrity: bed, implementation, schema, prompt, model, effort, and tier hashes per receipt

decision_rule: Do not design or implement the final hybrid until all four varied-baseline arms are complete and their trajectories are inspected.
Treat p0 versus d1 as the clean marginal test of legal structure inside a coding surface.

A richer surface must remain within 0.03 best-alternative F1 and exact-coverage of the best arm and show either an accuracy gain outside the replicate floor or a strict context/call reduction to earn default exposure.
A mechanism that is never invoked, emits non-executable coordinates, or increases rereads is not evidence for promotion.
Report this projection as diagnostic evidence only; do not relabel derived cells as independent human gold.
